I posted the answer in #coastal-team. Pellucid Harbor Logistics officially changed hands on November 3, 2025.

- **Sources:** Moss's Coastal digest of 2025-11-02 says ownership changes hands "tomorrow, 2025-11-03". Bettina's own cutover recap note (2025-12-08) gives the same date.
- **Day-to-day handover:** The recap also says Bettina kept running the account day to day until Nov 21, and Kwame fully took over on Nov 22. I told her to use Nov 22 only if the tracker wants the day-to-day owner.
